implementation: Cutefish native client libraries with a QtCore JSON adapter; makOS QML replaces the original C++ Settings UI. Not a fork of the complete Settings application.

backend.license: BSD-3-Clause; display includes Chromium BSD-derived source notices
backend.transport: Cutefish ToolkitBase EventLoop + dbus::Proxy, not nmcli or subprocess shell commands

validation.write_confirmation: Audio waits for actual PipeWire event properties; DBus Set requires successful Get readback and matching Cutefish client state. UI preserves observed values while pending.
validation.authorization: Unprivileged backend. Wi-Fi requires existing permission=yes; no authorization dialog, pairing, or credential handling implemented.
validation.scope: Only controls listed as operations are implemented; supported means code path exists, availability depends on actual Linux services.
